article: Build and install OpenSSL on Windows
scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations; compared all build instructions and command examples, checked release support status, Perl/NASM/MSVC prerequisites, x64 architecture setup, install privileges, metadata, internal links, and image.
findings: Removed duplicate future publication dates, preserved the original publication date (2023-04-07), and set lastmod to 2026-11-25 in all 13 editions.
Replaced the unsupported OpenSSL 3.1.0 example with 3.5.9, the supported LTS patch available on 2026-11-25; added a reminder to verify the latest supported patch at build time.
Updated the Perl and NASM examples to current stable releases and clarified PATH/toolchain requirements.
Clarified that source builds are optional when a suitable binary distribution works; specified the x64 Visual Studio tool prompt and corrected vcvarsall to amd64.
Recorded default x64 install location and administrator requirement, with --prefix as a writable alternative. Replaced Wikipedia with official OpenSSL and Microsoft references.
